einzeiler: Writers from history whose literary works allegedly crossed the boundary of death.
kurzfassung: This episode explores historical authors whose writings were allegedly channeled from beyond the grave through séances and automatic writing. It highlights Victor Hugo delaying book releases under the guidance of death, and printers like T.P. James completing unfinished works by Charles Dickens. Additionally, the podcast examines the tragic real-life romance of Francesca da Rimini immortalized by Dante.
stichpunkte: Victor Hugo delayed his book publications on a staggered schedule after supposedly speaking with death.
The Ghost Club was founded in Victorian England by academics and writers to investigate psychical phenomena.
O. Henry's ghost supposedly dictated a collection of short stories through a Ouija board eight years after his death.
An itinerant printer named T.P. James claimed to channel Charles Dickens to finish the novel The Mystery of Edwin Drood.
Rocket Money is highlighted as a financial app that helps users track spending and cancel unwanted subscriptions.
Francesca da Rimini's tragic 13th-century love affair and murder were immortalized by Dante in the Inferno.

kapitel.titel: Victor Hugo and the Ghost Club
The Tragedy of Francesca da Rimini

beschreibung:
Everyone loves a good ghost story, but literature and spirits have a relationship that is older than some might think.
